nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending owner address used by the 2-phase ownership transfer.
Ops address in OpsManaged granting owner-or-ops privileges.
Finalization flag in Finalizable; once true transfer restrictions are lifted.
ERC20 token name stored in ERC20Token.
ERC20 token symbol stored in ERC20Token.
ERC20 token decimals stored in ERC20Token.
Total token supply, mutated by burn and initialized in the constructor.
Mapping of account balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and reclaimTokens.
Nested allowance mapping mutated by approve and transferFrom.
EximchainToken freeze flag blocking all transfers when true.
Untrusted external caller address used for ownership checks, transfers, approvals and burning.
Constructor of Owned that sets owner = msg.sender.
View helper returning whether an address equals owner; backs the onlyOwner modifier.
Owner-only first phase of 2-phase ownership transfer; sets proposedOwner.
Second phase; requires msg.sender == proposedOwner and moves ownership.
Owner-only setter for the ops address in OpsManaged.
View helper returning whether an address equals the non-zero opsAddress.
View helper combining isOwner and isOps checks.
Owner-only function permanently setting finalized = true.
Checked addition helper operating on uint256 operands.
Checked subtraction helper requiring a >= b.
Checked multiplication helper verifying r / a == b.
Unchecked division helper returning a / b.
Constructor of ERC20Token initializing metadata, supply and the initial holder balance.
Base ERC20 transfer moving balances from msg.sender to a recipient.
Base ERC20 transferFrom debiting balances and allowance of the spender.
Sets the allowance granted by msg.sender to a spender.
View function returning the stored balance of an account.
Hook enforcing pre-finalization transfer restrictions with owner/ops privileges.
Eximchain transfer override that requires the token not to be frozen.
Eximchain transferFrom override that requires the token not to be frozen.
Burns msg.sender tokens, reducing balances and total supply.
Owner-only function moving tokens held by the contract to the owner.
Owner-only function permanently disabling token transfers.
Raw uint256 addition (a + b) in Math.add whose overflow is only caught by a post-hoc require.
Raw uint256 subtraction (a - b) in Math.sub guarded only by require(a >= b).
Raw uint256 multiplication (a * b) in Math.mul whose overflow is checked after the fact.

edges.reason: The Owned constructor assigns owner directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
completeOwnershipTransfer authorizes solely on msg.sender == proposedOwner.
Base transfer debits balances indexed by msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes allowance keyed by msg.sender as spender.
approve writes the allowance entry for msg.sender.
burn debits the balance of msg.sender.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
initiateOwnershipTransfer writes the proposedOwner state variable.
completeOwnershipTransfer overwrites owner with msg.sender.
completeOwnershipTransfer clears proposedOwner to address(0).
setOpsAddress writes the opsAddress state variable.
finalize sets the finalized flag to true.
Constructor stores the token name.
Constructor stores the token symbol.
Constructor stores the token decimals.
Constructor sets tokenTotalSupply.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to the initial token holder.
transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
transferFrom updates source and destination balances.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
burn subtracts the amount from balances[account].
burn reduces tokenTotalSupply via checked subtraction.
reclaimTokens moves the contract balance to the owner.
freeze sets the frozen flag to true.
EximchainToken.transfer reads the frozen flag as a guard.
EximchainToken.transferFrom reads the frozen flag as a guard.
validateTransfer reads finalized to bypass restrictions.
EximchainToken.transfer calls validateTransfer before delegating to super.
EximchainToken.transferFrom calls validateTransfer before delegating to super.
burn calls balanceOf to verify the caller has enough tokens.
reclaimTokens calls balanceOf for the contract address.
onlyOwner modifier invokes isOwner(msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier invokes isOwner(msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier invokes isOwner(msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier invokes isOwner(msg.sender).
onlyOwner modifier invokes isOwner(msg.sender).
validateTransfer calls isOwner on the recipient address.
validateTransfer requires isOwnerOrOps for the sender.
isOwnerOrOps delegates to isOwner.
isOwnerOrOps delegates to isOps.
Math.add performs the raw uint256 addition guarded by require(r >= a).
Math.sub performs the raw uint256 subtraction guarded by require(a >= b).
Math.mul performs the raw uint256 multiplication checked afterwards.
transfer credits the recipient using Math.add.
transfer debits the sender using Math.sub.
transferFrom debits the source balance using Math.sub.
transferFrom credits the recipient using Math.add.
burn subtracts from balances using Math.sub.
reclaimTokens subtracts the contract balance using Math.sub.
reclaimTokens credits the owner using Math.add.
isOwner compares the _address parameter with owner.
isOps compares the _address parameter with opsAddress.
isOwnerOrOps forwards the _address parameter to isOwner and isOps.
initiateOwnershipTransfer stores the _proposedOwner parameter.
setOpsAddress stores the _newOpsAddress parameter.
Math.add adds operand a.
Math.sub subtracts operand b from a.
Math.mul multiplies operand a.
Math.div divides operand a.
Math.add adds operand b.
Math.sub subtracts operand b.
Math.mul multiplies operand b.
Math.div divides by operand b.
Local r holds the raw addition result in Math.add.
Constructor writes the _name parameter into tokenName.
Constructor writes the _symbol parameter into tokenSymbol.
Constructor writes the _decimals parameter into tokenDecimals.
Constructor writes the _totalSupply parameter into tokenTotalSupply.
Constructor assigns the supply to the _initialTokenHolder parameter.
balanceOf reads balances indexed by the _owner parameter.
approve stores the allowance for the _spender parameter.
transfer credits the _to parameter.
transferFrom credits the _to parameter.
EximchainToken.transfer forwards the _to parameter to super.transfer.
EximchainToken.transferFrom forwards the _to parameter to super.transferFrom.
transfer uses the _value parameter in balance arithmetic.
transferFrom uses the _value parameter in balance and allowance arithmetic.
approve stores the _value parameter as allowance.
transferFrom debits balances indexed by the _from parameter.
validateTransfer authorizes the _sender parameter via isOwnerOrOps.
burn subtracts the _amount parameter from balances and total supply.
Local account holds msg.sender and indexes the burn balance.
Local amount holds the contract balance moved by reclaimTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The _address parameter only feeds the isOwner access-control check and should be folded into it.
The _proposedOwner parameter only feeds the initiateOwnershipTransfer state write.
The _newOpsAddress parameter only feeds the setOpsAddress state write.
Operand a exists only to feed the Math arithmetic helpers, folded into Math.add.
Operand b exists only to feed the Math arithmetic helpers, folded into Math.add.
Local r is a temporary only used inside Math.add.
The _name parameter is only stored by the ERC20Token constructor.
The _symbol parameter is only stored by the ERC20Token constructor.
The _decimals parameter is only stored by the ERC20Token constructor.
The _totalSupply parameter is only used to initialize the constructor state.
The _initialTokenHolder parameter is only used for the constructor balance assignment.
The _owner parameter is only used as the balanceOf lookup key.
The _spender parameter is only used as the approve allowance key.
The _to parameter is only a recipient argument of transfer and related transfer functions.
The _value parameter is only an arithmetic operand of transfer/transferFrom.
The _from parameter is only the source key of transferFrom.
The _sender parameter is only used by the validateTransfer access check.
The _amount parameter is only the burn arithmetic operand.
Local account is a temporary alias of msg.sender inside burn.
Local amount is a temporary holding the contract balance inside reclaimTokens.
